Primary Sedimentation 	6 Removes solids from the wastewater by gravity.
Activated Sludge Biological Treatment 	6 Activated sludge consists of microorganisms that consume non-settleable and dissolved organic contaminants which form a settleable floc.
Secondary Clarification 	6 Removes biological floc from the wastewater which then mostly becomes part of the waste sludge.
Tertiary Treatment 	6 The filtration process is used to remove or reduce suspended or colloidal matter from a liquid stream by passing the water through a bed of graded granular material.
Microfiltration Feedwater Wet Well 	6 Tertiary treated wastewater is diverted to this wet well.
2 Million Gallon Microfiltration Equalization Tank 	6 ...used to adjust the water level of the Microfiltration Feedwater Wet Well.

Microfiltration 	6 The wastewater flow from the wet well is then split into two parallel trains, containing eighteen (18) parallel Memcor microfiltration units in total. The microfiltration units are periodically backwashed to clean the membranes...
the effluent to the microfiltration station is pretreated with sodium hypochlorite and aqua ammonia ... and then fed into automatic self-cleaning 500-micron strainers.
The microfiltration filtrate is then fed into two separate RO process trains.
the pH of the treated water from the microfiltration units may need to be adjusted with sulfuric acid to protect the RO filters from calcium carbonate precipitation.
Ammonia is added into RO permeate before entering the AOP.
The AOP includes two (2) low-pressure ultraviolet (UV) irradiation trains and hypochlorous acid addition.
AWPF Pumping Station 	6 The AOP effluent is stabilized and then distributed from the AWPF Pumping Station.
The Sludge Blending Tank blends primary sludge and thickened waste activated sludge before it goes to the anaerobic digesters.
